enhancedupload-desc: Waxay bixisaa bog gaar ah oo leh ikhtiyaarka lagu soo gelin karo hal ama dhowr fayl wiki-ga.
enhancedupload-failed-dialog-label: {{PLURAL:$1|Hal fayl|$1 fayl}} lama soo gelin karin
enhancedupload-alert-missing-files: Looma dooran wax faylal ah oo la soo geliyo
enhancedupload-ve-dialog-title-exists: Fayl leh magacan ayaa hore u jiray. Fadlan geli magac fayl oo cusub
enhancedupload-preview-widget-label: Faylashan ayaa loo doortay in la soo geliyo
enhancedupload-attachments-tag-no-attach: Wax faylal ah lama lifaaqin. Si aad fayl ugu darto, soo geli fayl ama ku dar fayl hore ugu jira wiki-ga.
enhancedupload-ve-dialog-duplicate-confi: Faylkan waa nuqul. Ma rabtaa inaad beddelkiisa geliso faylka hore u jiray? Haddii kale, wax fayl ah lama gelin doono.
enhancedupload-config-alignment-help: Dejinta isu toosinta sawirrada lagu jiido laguna rido tifaftiraha muuqaalka
enhancedupload-config-type-help: Dejinta nooca sawirrada lagu jiido laguna rido tifaftiraha muuqaalka
enhancedupload-config-height-help: Dejinta dhererka sawirrada lagu jiido laguna rido tifaftiraha muuqaalka. Meesha bannaan ka tag si dhererka loogu cabbiro iyadoo la raacayo ballaca. Haddii labadaba bannaan laga tago, cabbirka caadiga ah ayaa la isticmaali doonaa.
enhancedupload-config-width-help: Dejinta ballaca sawirrada lagu jiido laguna rido tifaftiraha muuqaalka. Meesha bannaan ka tag si ballaca loogu cabbiro iyadoo la raacayo dhererka. Haddii labadaba bannaan laga tago, cabbirka caadiga ah ayaa la isticmaali doonaa.
enhancedupload-config-extensions-label: Oggolow noocyada MIME ee aan iswaafaqin (khatar amni oo suurtagal ah)
enhancedupload-config-extensions-help: Oggolow in la soo geliyo faylasha leh kordhinno faylal oo aan la jaanqaadi karin noocyada MIME. Digniin: khatar amni oo suurtagal ah.
enhancedupload-upload-warning-exists: Magaca faylkan hore ayuu u jiray
enhancedupload-upload-warning-was-delete: Magaca faylkan hore ayaa loo tirtiray.
enhancedupload-upload-error-duplicate: Fayl la mid ah faylkan ($1) ayaa hore loo tirtiray.
enhancedupload-upload-error-badfilename: Magaca faylka $1 wuxuu ka kooban yahay xarfo aan ansax ahayn.
enhancedupload-upload-error-unhandled: Qalad aan la maareyn ayaa dhacay.
enhancedupload-warning-dialog-upload-lab: {{PLURAL:$1|Digniin ayaa|Digniino ayaa}} ka dhacday {{PLURAL:$1|faylkan la soo geliyey|faylashan la soo geliyey}}
enhancedupload-ve-attachmentinspector-ti: Cinwaanka goobta faylasha lagu soo bandhigo
enhancedupload-ve-attachmentinspector-pr: Aqoonsi la geliyo magaca faylka ka hor
